payload.summary: extractSafetyFindings takes about 89 seconds on a single 200,000-character passage, in the 260-character trimming step before any pattern runs
payload.detail: Found 2026-09-25 while adding a linear-time guard for the #GHC4XZ transfer pattern (PR B). The patterns themselves are linear (four 200k-character hostile inputs each under 500 ms via a tests-only hook), but extractSafetyFindings in src/lib/clinical-safety.ts spent about 89 s on one 200k-character passage in its trimming step. Real passages are chunk-sized, so this is unlikely to bite in normal use, but any caller that passes whole-document text would stall the thread. Not measured: which input sizes real callers pass. Likely fix: bound the input before trimming and add a timing test.
